## Notes

- **Landing on this board.** `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**` are objectui's governed surfaces: a PR touching any stays draft until an APPROVED review by `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`); then the seat lands it (ready + auto-merge → the merge queue), unless the approver already did. The dev-side governed pre-check is `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test PATHS` in this repo.
- **Changesets.** `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` decides: a `skills/**`-only PR owes none; when one is owed for a docs-only change it is an EMPTY-frontmatter changeset; the `skip-changeset` label object on this board is a phantom wired to nothing — ⛔ never apply it.
- **Comments and bodies.** objectui's `AGENTS.md` bans model identifiers in comments and bans cross-file `path:line` citations in PR bodies, changesets and docs (rule 11): devs cite by quoted strings and symbol names. Claims spell the ceiling as `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with `MANDATORY` cited on the same line.
- **Gates for `skills/**` edits**: `check:skills-paths`, `check:skill-examples` (a `--build-filter` scoped build under objectstack's `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; marked fences only), `check:skill-eval-tokens`, `check-doc-links`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-types`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check:governed-queue-guard`. Container Node v22.22.0 is below jsdom's floor under `engine-strict`: devs install with `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false` and record the deviation.
- **Writes to this board** go through the objectstack relay with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui` (`post-stamped.mjs --repo=objectstack-ai/objectui`, `label-write.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`); this repo carries no `fleet-write.yml` of its own.
